events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened its gates in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, music, and peace. What's your favourite iconic Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee, in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today, 49 years since we lost the King of Rock and Roll. His music still moves millions.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Influential American rapper Tupac Shakur tragically died in Las Vegas in 1996, six days after being shot in a drive-by shooting.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since the world lost a lyrical genius. Tupac Shakur's impact on hip-hop and culture remains profound.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57! That iconic album cover and timeless tracks. Still spinning it today?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still delivering those Pretenders hits.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless single 'Imagine' was released in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Song
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music listening.

angles.name: Remember Your First iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped! Remember the click wheel and carrying '1,000 songs in your pocket'?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the iconic James Bond film franchise, marking the release date of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and which theme song gets you shaken, not stirred?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and peace activist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic genius and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true showman. His voice and legacy live on.
